entries.content_osis: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6445"/><title type="x-s2">PSALM 81</title> <title type="x-s3"><reference osisRef="Ps.81.1-Ps.81.16">Psa 81:1-16</reference>. Gittith--(See on <reference osisRef="Ps.8.1">Psa 8:1</reference>, title). A festal Psalm, probably for the passover (compare <reference osisRef="Matt.26.30">Mt 26:30</reference>), in which, after an exhortation to praise God, He is introduced, reminding Israel of their obligations, chiding their neglect, and depicting the happy results of obedience.</title> <div sID="gen9874" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6445"/><hi type="bold">1. our strength--</hi>(<reference osisRef="Ps.38.7">Psa 38:7</reference>). <div eID="gen9874" type="x-p"/>

In this passage, "should have," "would have," &c., are better, "should" and "would" expressing God's intention at the time, that is, when they left Egypt. <chapter eID="Ps.81"/>
